Container.Name: investigatarr
Container.Overview: Checks your Unraid server's security and gives it a score out of 100, with a fix for every finding. Looks at management access (Telnet, HTTP, UPnP, SSH, FTP), passwords and password reuse, SMB and NFS shares, Docker containers, VMs and exposed services. Read-only by default: it mounts the host read-only and needs no Docker socket and no privileged mode. Optional cleanup lists old containers, unused appdata and empty shares and files, with Delete buttons and a 30-day recycle bin if you turn them on. Free forever: no paid tiers, no Pro account, no subscriptions.

Config.Name: Host root (read-only)
Config.Description: Your server's filesystem, mounted read-only so Investigatarr can read its settings. Do not make this writable.

Config.Name: Reports
Config.Description: Where the report page and report.json are saved

Config.Name: Scan interval (hours)
Config.Description: Rescan every N hours. 0 runs once and stops.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the report page (host networking, so pick a free port)

Config.Name: Allow delete
Config.Description: yes shows Delete buttons in the Cleanup list. Deleted files go to a recycle bin first. Also needs the two mappings below.

Config.Name: Recycle bin days
Config.Description: Days deleted files stay in the recycle bin before they are removed for good

Config.Name: Shares (for delete)
Config.Description: Only needed for deleting. Set to /mnt/user to let Investigatarr move clutter to its recycle bin. Leave empty to stay read-only.

Config.Name: Docker socket (for delete)
Config.Description: Only needed to remove old containers. Set to /var/run/docker.sock. Leave empty otherwise.
